author: ValWood
body:
**UniProt UniRule (ID and label):**


GO:0019878 | L-lysine biosynthetic process via aminoadipic acid | IEA with UPA00033


**Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBP4H10.15

**Description of issue**

this is  a tandem fusion protein in pombe, but  it is a fusion of
ribosomal protein subunit L21/aconitate hydratase,
neither of which appear to be lysine biosynthesis pathway.
title: UniRule2GO issue: GO:0019878 | L-lysine biosynthetic process via aminoadipic acid | IEA with UPA00033
